title: 上海智能制造行动计划的2028
subtitle: 五百家工厂与六百台机器人密度

article.en:
At the China International Industry Fair, Shanghai launched a new action plan for intelligent manufacturing on Oct 12. It aims to build 500 advanced intelligent factories in the city and raise robot density to 600 robots for every 10,000 workers by 2028.

The plan lists four major projects and 19 key tasks. Every key manufacturing company is expected to run a smart factory. More than 2,000 AI-based manufacturing scenarios are expected to be in operation. The city also plans to put about 8,000 humanoid robots into factories by 2028. The scale of AI-powered intelligent equipment is expected to reach more than 200 billion yuan, and the system integration industry is set to grow to 100 billion yuan.

Officials say the goal is to connect AI with real production. Large models will be used on production lines, and smart agents will join the manufacturing process to reshape production models. Shanghai also wants to build a modern industrial system and welcome more foreign companies to invest and settle down.
article.zh: 在中国国际工业博览会上，上海于10月12日发布了新一代智能制造行动计划。计划提出，到2028年在全市建成500家先进智能工厂，并把机器人密度提高到每万名员工600台。 计划列出四个重大项目和19项重点任务，要求重点制造业企业都建有智能工厂，推动超过2000个人工智能赋能的制造场景投入运行。全市还计划到2028年在工厂部署约8000台人形机器人，人工智能赋能的智能装备产业规模预计将超过2000亿元，智能制造系统集成产业将增至1000亿元。 官方表示，目标是让人工智能真正对接生产实际。大模型将用于生产线，智能体将融入制造流程，从而重塑生产模式。上海还希望建设现代化产业体系，吸引更多外资企业来投资兴业。

vocab.ex: Every key manufacturing company should run a smart factory.
vocab.note: manufacture 的名词形式，是产业类外刊高频词

vocab.ex: The city plans to build 500 intelligent factories.
vocab.note: intelligent manufacturing 智能制造；也可说 smart

vocab.ex: Every key company is expected to run a smart factory.
vocab.note: 复数 factories，注意 y 变 i 再加 es

vocab.ex: The plan wants a robot density of 600 per 10,000 workers.
vocab.note: robot density 机器人密度；也指人口密度

vocab.ex: Shanghai launched a new action plan on Oct 12.
vocab.note: launch 指正式启动、发布；发布产品也可用 launch

vocab.ex: The scale of AI equipment is expected to reach 200 billion yuan.
vocab.note: on a large scale / at scale 指「大规模」

vocab.ex: The intelligent equipment industry will grow fast.
Large models will be used on production lines.
vocab.note: production line 生产线，是四级高频搭配

vocab.ex: Shanghai wants a modern industrial system.
vocab.note: industrial system 产业体系；industry 是名词

vocab.ex: The city wants to build a modern industrial system.
vocab.note: modern 修饰体系、技术；注意 modern 与 modernize 的区别

vocab.ex: More foreign companies are welcome to invest and settle down.
vocab.note: invest in sth / invest 是不及物用法

translation.title: 智能制造与产业升级
translation.brief: 以下五句来自当天的上海智能制造行动计划报道，按「发布—目标—任务—路径—展望」推进。重点练数字目标与名词搭配。

sentences.cn: 上海于10月12日发布行动计划，以加快新一代智能制造的发展。
sentences.ref: Shanghai launched an action plan on Oct 12 to speed up the development of next-generation intelligent manufacturing.

hints.struct: 主语 + launched + 不定式表目的

pts.t: 「发布行动计划」用 launch an action plan；launch 强调正式启动，比 issue 更贴政策语境。
「加快……的发展」用 to speed up the development of，speed up 后接名词。
next-generation intelligent manufacturing 中 next-generation 作定语，复合形容词要带连字符。
具体日期用介词 on：on Oct 12；月份前不加 on 的是年份，如 in 2028。

sentences.cn: 到2028年建成500家先进智能工厂，机器人密度提高到每万名员工600台。
sentences.ref: The plan aims to build 500 advanced intelligent factories and raise robot density to 600 robots per 10,000 employees by 2028.

hints.struct: aims to do + and + 第二个动词原形

pts.t: aim to do sth 是「计划做某事」，aims 后要加 to 再跟动词原形。
build 与 raise 并列时共用同一个 to：to build ... and raise ...。
「机器人密度」用 robot density；密度搭配 density of 或作名词直接用。
by 2028 表示「到 2028 年为止」；until 2028 是「直到 2028 年都……」，意思不同。

sentences.cn: 计划包括四个重大项目和19项重点任务，推动超过2000个智能制造场景投入运行。
sentences.ref: The plan includes four major projects and 19 key tasks to push more than 2,000 AI-empowered manufacturing scenarios into real use.

hints.struct: includes A and B + 不定式表目的

pts.t: include 后直接跟宾语，不再加 that；四个项目与十九项任务并列要用 and 连接。
key tasks 是「重点任务」；「关键任务」也可用 key tasks，但「重点」更贴近任务。
「落地、投入运行」用 into real use 或 put into operation，比 literally 地道。
more than 2,000 是「超过 2000 个」，后面的名词用复数 scenarios。

sentences.cn: 官方还表示，将把大模型用于生产线，并让智能体融入制造流程，从而重塑生产模式。
sentences.ref: Officials also said that large models will be applied on production lines and that smart agents will join the manufacturing process to reshape production models.

hints.struct: said that ... and that ...（两个 that 从句）

pts.t: 两个并列的宾语从句都要加 that，第二个 that 不能省略，否则结构不平行。
「用于生产线」用 be applied on production lines；apply sth to/on sth，介词是 on。
reshape production models 中 reshape 是及物动词，后面直接跟宾语，不加介词。
「智能体」是 AI agent 的常见译法；join the manufacturing process 表「融入流程」。

sentences.cn: 随着装备产业规模突破2000亿元，上海希望吸引更多外资企业来投资兴业。
sentences.ref: As the intelligent manufacturing equipment industry grows to more than 200 billion yuan, Shanghai hopes to attract more foreign companies to invest and settle down.

hints.struct: As 引导时间/伴随状语 + 主句

pts.t: As 引导伴随状语从句，主句用现在时；「随着」不要写成 Along with。
grows to 表示「增长到」；数字 2000 亿元写成 200 billion yuan。
hope to do sth 中 hope 后加 to；「希望吸引……」写成 hope to attract。
「投资兴业」用 invest and settle down，settle down 指「落户、定居」，比 stay 更贴。

exprs.note: launch 指正式启动、发布政策或产品。
speed up 是动词短语，后接名词。
复合形容词作定语，带连字符。
工厂是可数名词，数字后用复数。
密度是产业类高频名词。
per 表示「每」，数字间用逗号。
by 表示「到……为止」，until 含义不同。
and 连接两个并列宾语。
AI-empowered 表示「被 AI 赋能的」。
put ... into real use / operation 是外刊常用。
apply sth on/to sth，介词用 on。
join 后直接跟流程，不加 into。
reshape 是及物动词，后面直接跟宾语。
attract 后直接跟宾语，foreign companies 复数。

translation.classroomNote: 课堂速练用的两句（2 句模式默认出这两句；5 句全练出全部）
